content: Kiristtoosi Nuussi Gaannatiyaawaa
Ta naatoo, nagaraa hintte oothennaadan, taani hawaa hinttenttoo xaafay; shin ooninne nagaraa oothooppe, Aawuwaa matan nuussi gaannatiyaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosi, Xilluu, de7ee.
Qassi nuuni nu nagaraa atto geetettussaa Kiristtoosa bagganna demmeetto; Kiristtoosi yarshshetteeddawe asaa ubbaa nagaraa digganaassappe attin, nu nagaraa xalalaa digganaassa gidenna.
Nuuni Xoossaa azazuwaa naagooppe, tumu A eriyaawaa hewan shaakkanaw danddayeetto.
Itti uray, “Taani A eray” giide, qassi A azazuwaa naagennan aggooppe, he uray wordduwaa; tumatethaykka aani baawa.
Shin A qaalaw azazettiya oona gidooppenne, he uray Xoossaa siiqiyaawe tumu poletteedda. Nuuni Xoossaan de7iyaawaa hawe nuuna erissee. Hewekka,
“Taani, Xoossaan de7ay” giya ooninne Kiristtoosi de7eeddawaadan de7anaw bessee.
Ooratha Azazuwaa
Ta siiqatoo, taani hinttenttoo koyiruwaappe de7iya eca azazuwaa xaafayppe attin, ooratha azazuwaa xaafikke; he eca azazuu hintte siseedda qaalaa.
Gidooppekka, taani hinttenttoo laa7enthuwaa ooratha azazuwaa xaafay; he azazuwaa tumatethaykka Kiristtoosaninne hinttenan beettee. Ayissi gooppe, dhumay dhayee; tumu poo7uu ha77i poo7ee.
Poo7uwaan de7ay giidde, bare ishaa ixxiyaa ooninne hanno gakkanaassikka dhumaani de7ee.
Bare ishaa siiqiyaa ooninne poo7uwan de7ee; he uran hara uraa dhubbiyaabay ayaynne baawa.
Shin bare ishaa ixxiyaa ooninne dhumaani de7ee; dhumaani hamettee. Dhumay A ayfiyaa qooqissi wotheedda diraw, haqa binttonne erenna.

content.text: Ta naatoo, Xoossay Kiristtoosa sunthaa diraw,
hintte nagaraa atto yaageedda diraw, taani
Aawotoo, koyiruwaappe de7iyaawaa hintte ereedda diraw,
Guutha naatoo, Xoossaa Aawuwaa hintte ereedda diraw,
Aawotoo, koyiruwaappe de7iyaawaa hintte ereedda diraw,
qassi xalahiyaa kaappuwaa hintte xooneedda diraw,

content: Ha alamiyaa woy alamiyaan de7iya ayaanne siiqoppite. Hintte ha alamiyaa siiqooppe, Xoossaa siiquu hinttenan baawa.
Ayissi gooppe, ha alamiyaan de7iyaa ubbabay, hewekka: asatethaa amuu, ayifiyan xeelliide kajjeeliyaawenne bare de7iyaawaan ceeqettiyaawe ha alamiyaappe yeeddawaappe attin, Xoossaappe yibeenna.
Ha alamiinne ha alamiyan asay amottiyaa ubbabay aadhdhana. Shin Xoossay geeddawaa oothiyaa uray medhinaw de7ana.
Kiristtoosa Eqettiyaawaappe Naagettiyaawaa

Ta naatoo, wodiyaa wurssethay matatteedda; Kiristtoosa eqettiyaawe sinthaappe yaanawaa hintte siseeddawaadan, haray atto ha77ikka A eqettiyaawanttu coratuu denddeeddino. Hewaa diraw, wodiyaa wurssethay matatteeddawaa nuuni hewan ereetto.

Ha eqettiyaawanttu nu bagga gidenna diraw, nu giddoppe keseeddino; ayissi gooppe, unttunttu nu bagga gidiyaabaa gidinttonne, nu giddon de7ana; shin unttunttuppe ooninne nu bagga gidennawe erettana mala, nu giddoppe keseeddino.
Shin Kiristtoosi hintte bolla Geeshsha Ayyaanaa gusseedda; qassi hintte ubbay tumuwaa eriita.
Tumuwaa hintte eriya dirawunne qassi tumuwaan wordduu ayaynne bayinnawaa hintte eriya diraw, taani hinttenttoo xaafayppe attin, tumuwaa hintte erenna diraw xaafikke.
Yesuusi Oketteedda Kiristtoosa gidiyaawaa erikke giya uraappe attin, wordduu oonee? Hewe Xoossaa Aawuwaanne Na7aa erikke giyaawe Kiristtoosa eqettiyaawaa.
Xoossaa Na7aa erikke giyaa oonanne Xoossaa Aawuukka erenna; Xoossaa Na7aa eray giya oonanne qassi Xoossaa Aawuukka eree.

Hewaa diraw, koyiruwaappe hintte siseeddawaa hintte wozanaan minissiide naagite. Koyiruwaappe siseeddawaa hintte naagooppe, hinttenttoo qassi Xoossaa Na7aannanne Xoossaa Aawuwaanna ittippetethay de7ana.
Qassi Kiristtoosi bare huuphew nuussi immana geeddawe medhinaa de7uwaa.
Taani hawaa hinttenttoo he hinttena balethiya asatuwaa diraw xaafaaddi.

Shin Kiristtoosi hintte bolla bare Geeshsha Ayyaanaa gusseedda. Geeshsha Ayyaanay hinttenan de7iya diraw, ooninne hinttena tamaarissana koshshenna; ayissi gooppe, A Geeshsha Ayyaanay hinttena ubbabaa tamaarissee. I tamaarissiyaawe tumuwaappe attin wordduwaa gidenna. Hewaa diraw Ayyaanaa Geeshshaa timirttew azazetiidde, Kiristtoosanna ittipetethaan de7ite.
Ta naatoo, qassi I qoncciyaa wode, nuuni yashshi bayinnawantta gidanaadaaninne, A yuussaa gallassi A sinthan nuuni yeellatennaadan, aananna ittippetethaan de7ite.
Kiristtoosi xillo gidiyaawaa hintte erooppe, xillobaa oothiyaa ubbay Xoossaa na7aa gidiyaawaa eranaw bessee.
